local F={Serial=0}
ExposedMembers.JAC_NativeTempleObservation={}
local function identity(city)
 return {Owner=city:GetOwner(),ID=city:GetID(),X=city:GetX(),Y=city:GetY()}
end
local function sameCity(city,target)
 return city and city:GetOwner()==target.Owner and city:GetID()==target.ID and city:GetX()==target.X and city:GetY()==target.Y
end
local holy=assert(GameInfo.Districts.DISTRICT_HOLY_SITE).Index
local shrine=assert(GameInfo.Buildings.BUILDING_SHRINE).Index
local temple=assert(GameInfo.Buildings.BUILDING_TEMPLE).Index
function F.Plan(city,label)
 local target=identity(city)
 local site
 for _,district in city:GetDistricts():Members() do
  if district:GetType()==holy and sameCity(district:GetCity(),target) then
   assert(not site,'multiple Holy Sites for fixture city')
   site=Map.GetPlot(district:GetX(),district:GetY())
   assert(district:IsComplete() and not city:GetDistricts():IsPillaged(holy,site:GetIndex()),
    label..': existing Holy Site is incomplete or pillaged; refusing duplicate construction')
  end
 end
 if not site then
  local plots=assert(Map.GetCityPlots():GetPurchasedPlots(city),'fixture purchased plots unavailable')
  local candidates={}
  for _,index in pairs(plots) do candidates[#candidates+1]=index end
  table.sort(candidates)
  for _,index in ipairs(candidates) do
   local q=Map.GetPlotByIndex(index)
   if q:GetOwner()==target.Owner and sameCity(Cities.GetPlotPurchaseCity(q),target)
    and Map.GetPlotDistance(city:GetX(),city:GetY(),q:GetX(),q:GetY())<=3
    and q:GetDistrictType()==-1 and q:GetImprovementType()==-1 and not q:IsCity()
    and not q:IsWater() and not q:IsMountain() and not q:IsImpassable() and not q:IsNaturalWonder() then site=q;break end
  end
 end
 assert(site,label..': no Holy Site or empty plot purchased by this exact city; carrier preparation is incomplete')
 assert(site:GetOwner()==target.Owner and sameCity(Cities.GetPlotPurchaseCity(site),target),
  label..': Holy Site plot belongs to another city')
 target.Plot=site:GetIndex()
 print('[JAC_NATIVE_TEMPLE_PLAN] fixture='..label..' owner='..target.Owner..' city='..target.ID..' plot='..target.Plot)
 return target
end
function F.Read(label,token)
 local t=assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_NATIVE_HOTSEAT_SAVE_FIXTURE_996'))
 local target=assert(t.Fixtures[label],'unknown temple fixture')
 local city=CityManager.GetCityAt(target.X,target.Y)
 assert(sameCity(city,target),label..': fixture city identity changed')
 local q=assert(Map.GetPlotByIndex(target.Plot))
 assert(q:GetOwner()==target.Owner and sameCity(Cities.GetPlotPurchaseCity(q),target),
  label..': fixture plot purchase city changed')
 local complete=false
 local present=false
 for _,district in city:GetDistricts():Members() do
  if district:GetType()==holy and Map.GetPlot(district:GetX(),district:GetY()):GetIndex()==target.Plot then
   assert(sameCity(district:GetCity(),target),label..': Holy Site belongs to another city')
   assert(q:GetDistrictType()==holy,label..': district/plot type mismatch')
   present=true
   complete=district:IsComplete() and not city:GetDistricts():IsPillaged(holy,target.Plot)
  end
 end
 local buildings=city:GetBuildings()
 local at={}
 for _,kind in ipairs(buildings:GetBuildingsAtLocation(target.Plot)) do
  local row=assert(GameInfo.Buildings[kind],'unknown fixture building')
  at[row.Index]=true
 end
 local function built(index)
  return buildings:HasBuilding(index) and at[index]==true and not buildings:IsPillaged(index)
 end
 local shrineReady=complete and built(shrine)
 local templeReady=shrineReady and built(temple)
 local count,slotType,slotValue
 if templeReady then
  count=buildings:GetNumGreatWorkSlots(temple)
  if count==1 then
   slotType=assert(GameInfo.GreatWorkSlotTypes[buildings:GetGreatWorkSlotType(temple,0)]).GreatWorkSlotType
   slotValue=buildings:GetGreatWorkInSlot(temple,0)
  end
  assert(count==1 and slotType=='GREATWORKSLOT_RELIC',label..': completed Temple lacks exact stock relic slot 0')
 end
 F.Serial=F.Serial+1
 local observed={Token=token,Read=F.Serial,Owner=target.Owner,ID=target.ID,X=target.X,Y=target.Y,Plot=target.Plot,
  Holy=complete,Shrine=shrineReady,Temple=templeReady,HolyPresent=present,
  ShrinePresent=buildings:HasBuilding(shrine),TemplePresent=buildings:HasBuilding(temple),
  SlotCount=count,SlotType=slotType,SlotValue=slotValue}
 ExposedMembers.JAC_NativeTempleObservation[label]=observed
 return observed
end
function F.Observe(label,stage)
 return F.Read(label,label..':'..stage)
end
function F.Ready(label,stage)
 local target=assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_NATIVE_HOTSEAT_SAVE_FIXTURE_996')).Fixtures[label]
 local request=assert(target.Request,label..': temple stage not requested')

 if not r[stage] then return false end
 print('[JAC_NATIVE_TEMPLE_READY] fixture='..label..' stage='..stage..' token='..r.Token..' read='..r.Read..' city='..r.ID..' plot='..r.Plot)
 return true
end

local function requestTemple(label,stage)
 local t=assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_NATIVE_HOTSEAT_SAVE_FIXTURE_996'))
 local target=assert(t.Fixtures[label])
 local token=label..':'..stage
 local r=assert(ExposedMembers.JAC_NativeTempleObservation[label],label..': UI temple observation missing')
 assert(r.Token==token and r.Owner==target.Owner and r.ID==target.ID and r.X==target.X and r.Y==target.Y and r.Plot==target.Plot,
  label..': mismatched temple observation')
 assert(type(r.Read)=='number' and (not target.Request or r.Read>target.Request.Read),label..': stale UI temple observation')
 assert(not target.Request or target.Request.Stage~=stage,label..': duplicate temple request')
 assert(stage=='Holy' or stage=='Shrine' or stage=='Temple','unknown temple stage')
 if stage~='Holy' then assert(r.Holy,label..': completed exact-city Holy Site not published') end
 if stage=='Temple' then assert(r.Shrine,label..': completed shrine not published') end
 local city=assert(CityManager.GetCityAt(target.X,target.Y))
 assert(city:GetOwner()==target.Owner and city:GetID()==target.ID,label..': Gameplay city identity changed')
 assert(r[stage] or not r[stage..'Present'],
  label..': existing '..stage..' is incomplete, pillaged, or in another plot; refusing duplicate construction')
 target.Request={Stage=stage,Token=token,Read=r.Read}
 Game:SetProperty('JAC_NATIVE_HOTSEAT_SAVE_FIXTURE_996',t)
 if not r[stage] then
  local queue=city:GetBuildQueue()
  local ok,value=pcall(function()
   if stage=='Holy' then
    queue:CreateIncompleteDistrict(assert(GameInfo.Districts.DISTRICT_HOLY_SITE).Index,target.Plot,100)
   else
    local kind=stage=='Shrine' and 'BUILDING_SHRINE' or 'BUILDING_TEMPLE'
    queue:CreateIncompleteBuilding(assert(GameInfo.Buildings[kind]).Index,target.Plot,100)
   end
  end)
  assert(ok,label..':'..stage..' request failed: '..tostring(value))
 end
 print('[JAC_NATIVE_TEMPLE_REQUEST] fixture='..label..' stage='..stage..' token='..token..' beforeRead='..r.Read..' city='..target.ID..' plot='..target.Plot..' alreadyComplete='..tostring(r[stage]))
 return 'requested '..label..' '..stage..'; fresh UI publication required'
end
